notes: No modern-fiction words found in this batch, so nothing removed. 'maps and globes' has no words of its own (flag kept); continents and world regions are separate because place names like Africa or Balkans don't read as map-and-globe vocabulary, while lines on a map, map words, kinds of maps and compass directions do. Renamed 'Magellan Strait' to the usual 'Strait of Magellan' and 'Halligan' to 'Halligan bar'. 911 is added to both fire station and police station (999 only to police station, as the UK form). Kept 'Pikes Peak' without an apostrophe (official US spelling) and 'Tenochtitlan' plain (usual English form). Entrée, éclair, gâteau, frappé, crêpe and ombré follow Merriam-Webster's main headword; check if you prefer the plain forms.
